{{$colorClasses = "bg-red-100 text-red-800"}} {{else if eq .status "cancelled"}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-cool-grey-100 text-cool-grey-800"}} {{end}} {{end}} {{/* Health variant statuses */}} {{if eq text-red-800"}} {{end}} {{end}} {{/* Link variant statuses */}} {{if eq .variant "link"}} {{if eq .status "pending"}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800"}} {{else if eq .status {{else if or (eq .status "approval-awaiting") (eq .status "awaiting")}} {{/* Clock/waiting icon */}} {{end}} {{end}} {{if .uppercase}}{{.status | printf "%s"}}{{else}}{{.status}}{{end}}
